name: PHP legacy shop
description: A procedural PHP script with SQL built from $_GET, shell_exec, md5 passwords, mt_rand tokens, a request-controlled include, unserialize on a cookie, reflected output, disabled TLS verification and a hard-coded password. Intentionally insecure, for education.
expected: Findings from the PHP token scanner.

fixes.title: Read the password from the environment
fixes.explanation: The password is no longer in the repository (rotate the exposed value).

fixes.title: Use a prepared statement
fixes.explanation: The search term is bound as a parameter instead of being concatenated into the SQL text.
edits: $result = mysqli_query($conn, "SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%" . $term . "%'");

fixes.title: Escape the argument
fixes.explanation: escapeshellarg() quotes the value so the shell treats it as one argument.

fixes.title: Use password_hash
fixes.explanation: password_hash uses a slow, salted algorithm.

fixes.title: Use random_bytes for the token
fixes.explanation: random_bytes is a cryptographically secure source.

fixes.title: Include only pages from a fixed map
fixes.explanation: The request only selects a key of an allow-list, so no arbitrary file can be included.

fixes.title: Decode JSON instead of unserializing
fixes.explanation: json_decode builds plain data, not arbitrary objects.

fixes.title: Escape the name before output
fixes.explanation: htmlspecialchars turns markup into harmless text.

fixes.title: Use only the base name of the file
fixes.explanation: basename() strips directory parts, so '../' cannot leave the uploads directory.
